mcp.bridgeWarning: Claude Desktop starts MCP servers over stdio, and its “Add custom connector” flow expects a remote server that speaks OAuth. This endpoint is neither: it is plain HTTP JSON-RPC authenticated with your Septimus token. Pasting the URL above into Claude Desktop directly will not connect. The config below runs the open-source mcp-remote bridge instead, which Claude Desktop launches locally and which forwards each call here with your token attached.
mcp.step1: Install Node.js on the machine running Claude Desktop — the bridge is started with npx.
mcp.step2: Open Claude Desktop → Settings → Developer → Edit Config. The file lives at:
mcp.step3: Paste the config below, then replace PASTE_YOUR_TOKEN_HERE with your token (use “Copy my token”, which copies the whole Bearer value).
mcp.step4: Quit Claude Desktop completely and reopen it. The tools above then appear under Connectors.
mcp.tokenNote: The token is your personal session token: it carries the same workspace access as your browser session and expires 72 hours after login. Treat it like a password, and copy a fresh one whenever Claude Desktop starts failing to connect. If the endpoint URL points at localhost, Claude Desktop must run on this same machine.
mcp.tokenUnavailable: Browser sessions are HttpOnly. Create a scoped API key for MCP instead.
